audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers ran a chart of Swain, Swain, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill. The packet chart and the already-audited mirror both say Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Swain. The page also awarded Swain 8/10 at Level 1, which nothing supports.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Swain, and the mordekaiser__swain audit records exactly that ('Level 1 Skill, Levels 2 through First item Mordekaiser, 2+ items Swain'). The prose on this page already agrees with the mirror — whys[1] through whys[5] and content.mid all describe Mordekaiser owning levels 2-5 and Swain reversing at two items. Only the chart rows disagreed.
audit.corrected: Full chart flipped to match the mirror, proposed as one atomic group: side and win paired row by row, plus rescaled ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are already accurate and specific: Mordekaiser peaks levels 3-5 on Death's Grasp into an isolated Obliterate, again on his first item; Swain's real spike is 2+ items when magic penetration beats Indestructible's shield and Demonic Ascension's drain outlasts it. phases[6].why was generic filler about 'your pattern at full power' and did not say why two items is the turn.
audit.corrected: phases[6].why now names Indestructible and the drain, matching spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracked only Realm of Death and never mentioned Death's Grasp, which is the ability that actually decides lane. Ability names were absent from the Do's and Don'ts entirely.
audit.why: Death's Grasp (E) pulls all enemies in an area, 700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s. Obliterate (Q) is 675 range on 8/7/6/5/4s and does increased damage when it hits a single enemy — the pull exists to create that isolation. Swain has no dash, so staying outside 700 is the entire defence. Realm of Death is 140/120/100s, so it is a once-per-lane-phase event, not a per-trade tracker. Mirror confirms Swain's own numbers: Nevermove 850 range 12-10s rooting on the return, Demonic Ascension 120s and indefinite while draining champions.
audit.corrected: tldr, phases[0].why, phases[1].why, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d now carry the real names and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Do's never mentioned Grievous Wounds even though the page's own itemization line calls anti-heal core.
audit.why: Indestructible stores damage he deals AND takes to create a shield he can consume as a heal — in an extended drain-versus-drain lane the Grievous Wounds timing is the trade, not a nice-to-have.
Common Mistakes already lists the three real errors: getting isolated low inside his R, standing in Death's Grasp, and fighting low with no drain up. No elo language present anywhere on the page.

edits.before: AP brawl — build MR, W %HP-poke, drain in his realm. Swain wins the Realm of Death cooldown windows.
edits.after: AP brawl — build MR, W-poke outside 700, drain inside his realm. Trade on Death's Grasp's 16s.

edits.before: W-poke and AA harass win the range war. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you has your key ability — no Nevermove root, no Death's Grasp pull, so it is a pure last-hitting contest.

edits.before: E-root into the pull is your whole kill setup. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Death's Grasp comes online at 2 and Obliterate hits harder on a lone target — stay outside his 700 pull range.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, your W chips his stacked HP and R drain outlasts Indestructible — this is where the lane finally turns.

edits.before: His 1v1 realm. R-drain him in it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1 — pop your R on entry and root him inside.

edits.before: Mordekaiser wastes Realm of Death — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Indestructible converts damage he takes into a heal — Grievous Wounds first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Death's Grasp is 16s at rank 1 and drags you into an isolated Q.

notes: The two packets disagree on the win rate for this pairing: swain's packet says Swain 54.17% over 240 games, while the mordekaiser__swain audit worked from 53.85% on Mordekaiser's side. Those cannot both be right. I did not touch diff / diffRating / tone on either page as a result — this page still reads HARD 6/10 while the mirror reads FAV 5/10 for Mordekaiser, which is at least directionally consistent, but the header wording is a human call.
